description.value: Multi-day luxury scenic rail through the BC interior and Canadian Rockies, daytime travel only with overnight hotel stops. Routes run Vancouver to Banff, Lake Louise, and Jasper via Kamloops, plus a Vancouver to Seattle Coastal Passage. Bikes are not carried in the coaches; a bicycle travels as oversized checked luggage moved separately by road and meets you at your hotel, likely for a surcharge. Confirm bicycle handling with the operator in advance.
